name: Seething Void cuts Empire's Grasp's cooldown by the native spell-mod system (#1107)
contract: 524804 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -5001 / DieSides 1 -> value -5000 ms, matching the tooltip's $/1000;s1 = 5 sec. Its EffectSpellClassMask dwordC bit20 (1048576) is an exact, singular match for Empire's Grasp (500704)'s own SpellFamilyFlags dwordC bit20 -- verified directly from Spell.dbc, not from the audit report's claim alone. There is no family-31 routing-table entry for 524804 and none is needed: no collision to resolve. Empire's Grasp's native RecoveryTime is 35000 ms. The harness's spell_modifier metric applies the player's native spell mods to a supplied base through Player::ApplySpellMod, so it reads the routed value without submitting a cast (Empire's Grasp requires a real enemy target and would need spell_hit_rating fixtures otherwise).
